change: Cancel obsolete viewport preparation at cooperative replay/layer boundaries using the same eligibility rules as presentation. Preserve same-stroke and same-transform prefixes. Stop immediately on source-revision/asset changes. Propagate to smart-document and GPU Canvas-reference renders; exports without a predicate remain independent.
fixture: Real UI switches from a 698x396 document containing one 1200-point soft brush stroke to a solid-color document during cold preparation. Observe abort, latest presented pixels and elapsed time from newDocument; do not replace renderer output.

validation.browser: 35 regression cases passed; after direct source guard 13 affected cases passed again. Added GPU cancellation/recovery case passes with real SwiftShader texture readback.
validation.production: 20 latency cases passed, plus controlled baseline and enabled repeat on the same build.
validation.unit: Final full suite and typecheck/build results recorded in roadmap.
validation.initialUnitFailure: Hook mock lacked assetStore; now matches actual editor identity and asserts same-stroke validity and changed-revision cancellation.
validation.gpuTestCorrection: Headless SwiftShader cannot present a browser swapchain; test now reads the actual GPU output texture, consistent with existing GPU tests.

reproduce: VITE_BENCHMARK=1 npm run build; use playwright.performance.config.ts with tests/render-cancellation-latency.e2e.ts. LUMA_CANCEL_BASELINE=1 disables only the cancellation predicate in the test wrapper for the control measurement.
limitations: Measurements are local Chromium observations, not universal hardware/browser guarantees.
Cancellation is cooperative; native canvas work and already-running workers/GPU commands are not preempted.
Already-completed correctly keyed caches may remain. Temporary canceled output is released and never presented.
GPU correctness uses SwiftShader; physical GPU timing remains unverified.
Dense Pen, heavy scripts, large-image import/export and other broad responsiveness gaps remain open.
